name: Instagram transcript benchmarks
description: Word-level measurements of what a hosted Whisper endpoint (@cf/openai/whisper on Cloudflare Workers AI) returns for Instagram-style audio. 151 uploads across four suites (encoding degradation, synthesised music beds, four TTS voices, and the writing layer) plus a latency set, scored against reference text with the included wer.py. Every row carries the URL of the write-up it came from. No accuracy percentage is published, because one voice reading one sentence is not a labelled corpus.
